title: Implement phishing-resistant MFA
businessImpact: High - Protects identities from credential harvesting attacks and bypasses traditional MFA push bombing.
explanation: Migrate administrative and finance users to FIDO2 / WebAuthn-based keys (such as YubiKeys or Windows Hello for Business). This eliminates risk from credential harvesting and session hijacking.

title: Enforce Credential Guard and LSA protection
businessImpact: High - Blocks LSASS memory dump tools like Mimikatz from harvesting credentials.
explanation: Enable Windows Defender Credential Guard via Group Policy (GPO) to isolate LSA secrets using virtualization-based security (VBS), preventing administrative hashes from being stolen from memory.

title: Implement DMARC, DKIM, and SPF protocols
businessImpact: Medium - Dramatically reduces successful brand impersonation and incoming phishing mail.
explanation: Configure a strict DMARC 'reject' policy coupled with verified DKIM keys and complete SPF lists to authorize external email senders, preventing domain spoofing.

title: Establish network micro-segmentation
businessImpact: Critical - Restricts attackers from performing lateral network scanning or remote execution.
explanation: Segment workstation subnets from server zones. Disable workstation-to-workstation communication (SMB/RPC) and enforce zero-trust access list verification at internal gateways.

title: Enable storage encryption and access log auditing
businessImpact: High - Guarantees data privacy and provides forensics visibility during exfiltration attempts.
explanation: Enable KMS-managed default server-side encryption for all buckets. Attach strict IAM bucket policies enforcing secure TLS connections and turn on AWS CloudTrail Object Logging.

title: Implement database query rate-limiting and masking
businessImpact: High - Restricts exfiltration volume and prevents exposure of sensitive data to admins.
explanation: Configure SQL server application proxies to block queries exceeding threshold limits for row retrieval. Mask PII fields (SSN, credit card, payroll details) for all non-finance roles.

title: Enforce central PowerShell auditing policies
businessImpact: Medium - Provides SIEM with transcript-level visibility of administrative tasks and attacks.
explanation: Enable PowerShell Module Logging, Script Block Logging, and Transcription GPOs. Ship events directly to the SIEM to flag base64 execution or obfuscated script signatures.

title: Deploy automated SOAR playbooks for endpoint containment
businessImpact: Critical - Slashes mean-time-to-containment (MTTC) from hours to seconds.
explanation: Build automated containment orchestrations that isolate workstations immediately if the EDR registers LSASS tampering or known malware commands, bypassing manual reviews.
